title: Check Whether a Number Is Even
description: Given an integer, write a function that determines whether the number is even.
explanation: An even number is a number that is divisible by 2.

title: Check Whether a Number Is Positive, Negative, or Zero
description: Given an integer, write a function that determines whether it is positive, negative, or zero.
explanation: Use conditional statements to distinguish between the three cases.

title: Generate a Multiplication Table
description: Write a function that generates the multiplication table from 1 to 9.
constraints: The result should be returned as a list.
explanation: You can use nested loops or list comprehensions.

title: Calculate the Sum from 1 to n
description: Given an integer n, write a function that returns the sum of all integers from 1 to n.
constraints: n is an integer greater than or equal to 1.
explanation: You can use a loop or a mathematical formula.

title: Reverse a String
description: Write a function that returns the given string in reverse order.
explanation: You can use Python slicing to reverse the string.

title: Count the Number of Vowels
description: Write a function that counts the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a string.
constraints: The input consists of lowercase English letters.
explanation: Iterate through the string and use a condition to check whether each character is a vowel.

title: Find the Maximum Value in a List
description: Write a function that returns the maximum value in a list of numbers.
explanation: You can use a built-in function or find the maximum value by iterating through the list.

title: Remove Duplicates from a List
description: Write a function that returns a new list with duplicate elements removed.
constraints: The original order of the elements must be preserved.
explanation: You can combine a set with a list to remove duplicates while preserving the order.

title: Sum the Values in a Dictionary
description: Write a function that returns the sum of all values in a dictionary containing numeric values.
explanation: Iterate through the dictionary values and calculate their sum.

title: Filter Even Numbers from a List
description: Write a function that returns a new list containing only the even numbers from the input list.
constraints: The input is a list of integers.
explanation: Iterate through the list and select elements that satisfy the given condition.
